text:
oncall-bot: PAGER (P2): Spike in 5xx errors from /v1/generate in us-west-2. Error rate ~18% over last 5m. Routing to oncall.

elaine: I'm taking this, thanks. Confirming oncall for us-west-2 is me. Starting triage.

ben: Noted — I'm available for comms. If customer-facing impact >10% we should draft a status update.

mohit: Logs show an influx of requests with malformed metadata header, looks like a client-side surge hitting a fallback path. Pinning a few traces now.

elaine: Repro locally with a synthetic load; error is from our request router returning 502 when a downstream transformer pool hits max-conns.

samira: Is there a quick mitigation? Rate-limit or fallback?

elaine: Toggling autoscale policy to allow burst capacity for transformer pool. Applying now.

oncall-bot: action: autoscale-policy update submitted by elaine. Change id: asg-775b.

mohit: Autoscale request accepted by control plane, but expected spin-up ~45s. In the meantime error rates remain elevated.

ben: Drafting initial statuspage message. Posting for review.

ben: Customer-facing draft: 
```
Initial update (Investigating) - Mar 15 14:02 UTC
We are investigating elevated 5xx errors for the text generation API in the us-west-2 region. Some requests are failing with 502 responses. Engineers are actively triaging and we will post updates every ~30 minutes or as the situation changes.
Affected: region us-west-2, text generation endpoints.
Impact: intermittent failed requests (approx 10-20% of requests) and increased latency.
```

samira: Good start. Add guidance for customers using dedicated capacity and a note about retries: "Customers on Dedicated capacity may be unaffected if pinned to other regions; consider retrying requests with exponential backoff."

ben: Updated draft: 
```
Initial update (Investigating) - Mar 15 14:02 UTC
We are investigating elevated 5xx errors for the text generation API in the us-west-2 region. Some requests are failing with 502 responses. Engineers are actively triaging and we will post updates every ~30 minutes or as the situation changes.
Affected: region us-west-2, text generation endpoints.
Impact: intermittent failed requests (approx 10-20% of requests) and increased latency.
Workarounds: Customers can retry failed requests with exponential backoff. Dedicated customers can route to other regions or contact success for regional pinning.
```

product-sre: Suggest adding the next planned update ETA (15-20m) and a link to the support doc for retry best-practices.

ben: Finalized initial update and queued publish. Publishing now unless objections.

elaine: Go ahead. Also ping CSE to prepare inbound customer messages.

oncall-bot: statuspage: publish request queued by ben. page-id: rp-42.

ben: Published initial update at 14:07 UTC. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/rp-42

samira: Notifying top-tier customers via support-runbook. Template: "We've observed intermittent 5xx errors impacting generation - our engineers are investigating, ETA for next update ~15-20m."

mohit: Autoscale finished, new capacity added ~14:09 UTC. Observability shows error rate dropping but still ~6% over baseline.

elaine: Rolling a hotfix config to remove a failing fallback path that amplified errors under surge. Applying config-change: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal-config.redwood/api/set -d '{"feature.fallback_routing": false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer X'
```

oncall-bot: deploy: config-change applied by elaine, rollout id cfg-993.

mohit: After config change, errors back to baseline (~0.5%) and latency normalized. Observability shows steady traffic.

ben: Drafting update to mark "mitigated" and prepare resolved notice. Posting update for review: 
```
Update (Mitigated) - Mar 15 14:15 UTC
We have mitigated the elevated 5xx errors affecting the text generation API in the us-west-2 region. Root cause: surge of malformed headers triggering a fallback path that overloaded a transformer pool; autoscale and a configuration rollback removed the load amplification.
Impact: intermittent failed requests (peak 18%), now returning to normal.
Action taken: added burst capacity, rolled back fallback routing, monitoring for recurrence.
Next update: Resolved notice once stability confirmed (~15m).
```

samira: Looks good. Add a brief note that customers who experienced failures might want to replay requests. Also include contact pointer: support@redwood.ai.

ben: Updated. Queuing the mitigated update and preparing resolved at ~14:30 UTC after we see 15m of normal metrics.

product-sre: Internal note: tag incident with sev:P2, included post-incident action item to verify fallback routing safety and add a guard to reject malformed header early.

elaine: Agreed. I'll own the follow-up ticket and assign to mohit for root-cause writeup.

oncall-bot: incident: add-todo created todo-1215 assigned to mohit (root-cause writeup).

mohit: Will write RCA and include trace samples and the sequence that caused amplification.

ben: Publishing the "Mitigated" update now.

oncall-bot: statuspage: published update rp-42@mitigated at 14:17 UTC.

elaine: Monitoring window passed 15m with steady metrics. I recommend publishing resolved at 14:33 UTC.

ben: Draft resolved notice: 
```
Resolved - Mar 15 14:33 UTC
The incident affecting text generation in us-west-2 has been resolved. Error rates and latency have returned to normal. Root cause: malformed client headers hitting a fallback path which overloaded a transformer pool. Remediation: added burst capacity and disabled the vulnerable fallback routing. We will follow up with an RCA and preventative measures.
If you continue to see errors, please contact support@redwood.ai.
```

samira: Approved. Publishing resolved now.

oncall-bot: statuspage: published resolved notice rp-42@resolved at 14:34 UTC.

ben: Sent a summary to the incident-commits channel and flagged the RCA ticket. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :tada:

product-sre: Closing note: update our incident playbook to include a step to check for malformed client headers when generation errors spike.

elaine: Noted. Filing playbook change.

mohit: I'll attach logs and timeline to todo-1215.

samira: I'll follow up with support to surface any customer reports and make sure any high-urgency cases were contacted.

oncall-bot: incident closed by ben at 14:36 UTC.

ben: Thread summary: initial paging, autoscale + config rollback mitigated, mitigated/update published, resolved notice published, RCA ticket created (todo-1215)."
